topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I remember the day I planted that sapling, my hands small and eager, the soil gritty and full of promise. To see it gone, just...missing. The space where it stood is empty, a stark patch of bare earth that seems to echo the hollow spot in my chest. I wander around the yard, my steps aimless, as if by retracing my steps I might find it. The quiet of the afternoon seems too loud, the sky too vast. I wish it hadn’t been today, a normal day that now feels twisted and wrong. I keep thinking maybe I’m mistaken, that it’s still here and I’ve just forgotten where. But I know. I know.
